title: Scaffold a reproducible Quarto manuscript
text: One source, many outputs. text lives _sections/*.qmd; make.R renders journal .docx, preprint .pdf, working .html supplement, citation style journal name. Submission folder. make_submission() builds blinded manuscript (title page main text split way double-blind review asks ), figures 600 dpi renumbered order, cover letter, checklist, data--code compendium ready Zenodo Dryad, renv.lock included. Supplementary material independent references. Supplementary figures tables numbered Figure S1, Table S1, cited main text, can either travel document sit end main one. Supplementary text always goes document, reference list. Figures PNG, JPG TIFF 600 dpi, exported every render. Checks send anything: citations entry, cross- references target, figures nobody cites, title page longer matches manuscript, missing renv.lock.
